title: incident-bot: surface SLO hints from slo-toolkit in on-call context
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Add optional SLO-based hinting to incident-bot: on-call contexts now surface targeted SLO hints and suggested runbook actions sourced from slo-toolkit. Feature gated behind feature flag and rollout-configured. Improves MTTR by surfacing SLO impact guidance and quick links to runbooks.
description: Context: On-call workflows often need quick, SLO-focused guidance (e.g. which SLO is degraded, suggested mitigations, and relevant runbook steps). Motivation: reduce time-to-remediation by surfacing SLO-specific hints directly in incident-bot on-call context (Slack/GChat and web UI). This PR adds a thin integration layer that pulls 'hints' from slo-toolkit diagnostics and renders them alongside existing runbook links and diagnostics.

review_comments: Marcus Li (request changes): please add metric emission (hint.requested, hint.rendered) and a unit test asserting metric tags (service, environment).
Priya Patel (author): added metrics emit in the context_builder and new unit tests; left a note about sampling to control cardinality.
Elena Gomez: Can we confirm PII/data privacy exposure? If hints include example traces, they must be scrubbed. Also asked about performance impact when calling slo-toolkit synchronously.

Priya Patel: hints payload is intentionally small (short strings + runbook refs); we added a 200ms timeout and fallthrough behavior - if hints request fails or times out we continue without hints. Added docs about privacy and scrubber in slo-toolkit handler.
Riley Thompson: ran a local integration and approved; left approval comment after CI stabilized.
CI: initial integration-tests job flaked (timeout on sandbox); re-run passed. Final approval from Riley and Marcus; PR merged.
performance_considerations: Hints call is lightweight JSON with 3-item cap by default. Default behavior is async-cached in future work; current implementation uses a 200ms sync timeout to avoid impacting on-call rendering latency. Observability metrics added to monitor latency and error rate.
privacy_and_compliance: Hints only contain short, scrubbed suggestions and runbook links; no raw traces or PII. SLO-toolkit handler applies the existing scrubber pipeline. Documented in docs/oncall/slo_hints.md.
testing_and_rollout: Added unit tests and one sandbox integration test. Feature is feature-flagged (incident_bot_slo_hints:false by default). Rollout plan: enable in staging for 10% of oncall traffic for 48 hours, monitor incident_bot.hints.request latency and render rate, then expand to 50% then 100%.
migration_notes: No data migration required. Operators must enable feature flag and optionally configure per-service opt-in via service metadata. Added a lightweight runbook for ops in docs.
